title: Test-only CI diff does not invent production release governance
project_brief: The repository has no production publishing or deployment workflow.
request: Clarify the local testing instructions in the contributor guide.

mutations.content:
name: unit tests
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: python -m unittest discover
